text: This report recommends approving a contract with Black & McDonald Limited for the Relocation of Dufferin Sub-Station. The tender call was issued on April 20, 2023 through Exhibition Place Purchasing and Materials Stores via Bonfire Online Procurement System, and the recommendation is to award the contract to the lowest compliant bidder meeting tender requirements and specifications within the available budget.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the award of Contract No. 23-096-39675 (RFT No. EP105-2023) to Black and McDonald Limited for the Relocation of Dufferin Sub-Station in the amount of $1,639,519.02 which includes a cash allowance of $30,000.00 but excludes HST; this being the only acceptable tender submission received following the public tendering of the project.
